scenarios.title: Inline diff of src/cart.ts
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront and click src/cart.ts under Changes.
Click Inline in the diff toolbar.

scenarios.title: Conflicts dialog
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/payments-api, which is stopped in a merge with conflicts.
Click Resolve... on the Conflicts group in Changes.

scenarios.title: Merge tool
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/payments-api.
Click the first file of the Conflicts group: the three pane merge tool.
note: No control tool opens the current app's merge tool over its window, so the run starts both apps as git
mergetool on src/app.ts (MergeToolApp.svelte shows the same MergeEditor.svelte under a 38-point title bar).

scenarios.title: git mergetool window
steps: Set Git Manager up as git's mergetool (docs/wiki/usage/Git-Mergetool.md).
Run git mergetool in demo/acme/payments-api: a merge window opens for the first conflicted file.

scenarios.title: Blame
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront and double-click src/cart.ts.
Click Blame (the clock button) in the path bar: the blame gutter beside the line numbers.

scenarios.title: Log
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Press Shift+Cmd+L (View > Log) and click the merge commit of feature/checkout.

scenarios.title: Commit tab
steps: Open the Log of demo/acme/storefront.
Double-click the merge commit of feature/checkout: it opens in a commit tab.

scenarios.title: Branches and Stashes sidebar
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Press Shift+Cmd+E: branches, tags, the stash WIP: free shipping threshold and Worktrees.

scenarios.title: Branches popup
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Click the branch button (main) in the Changes title bar and point at feature/checkout.

scenarios.title: Pull and push menu
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront (one commit ahead of origin).
Click the arrow next to Sync in the Changes title bar: Pull, Push, Fetch.

scenarios.title: Shelf
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Choose Git > Uncommitted Changes > Shelve Changes... and shelve src/cart.ts.
Choose Git > Uncommitted Changes > Show Shelf: the Shelf tab of the bottom panel.

scenarios.title: Menu bar and Git menu
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Open each menu of the menu bar (File, Edit, View, Code, Git, Window, Help); compare items, not pixels.

scenarios.title: Push dialog
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Choose Git > Push...: the Push dialog with one commit to push.

scenarios.title: Interactive rebase
steps: Open the Log of demo/acme/storefront.
Right-click the third commit and choose Interactively Rebase from Here...

scenarios.title: Submodule changes
steps: Start the app on demo/extras/shop-app.
Changes shows the submodule themes/acme with new commits and modified content.

scenarios.title: Git LFS diff
steps: Start the app on demo/extras/media-site.
Click assets/hero.png under Changes: the LFS tag and both sizes in the diff.

scenarios.title: Settings
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Press Cmd+, (Git Manager > Settings...) and look at Appearance, then Editor, Git and Automation.

scenarios.title: Search in Settings
steps: Open Settings (Cmd+,) and type font in the search field.

scenarios.title: Color theme Monokai Charcoal
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
In Settings > Editor, pick Monokai Charcoal as the Dark theme; switch to dark mode.
note: The run sets darkColorTheme in both apps' settings.json; in light mode it shows the default light theme.

scenarios.title: GitHub settings
steps: Open Settings (Cmd+,) and choose GitHub: the sign-in choices.

scenarios.title: Git Console
steps: Turn on Settings > Git > Git Console, then click Refresh in Changes.
Choose View > Git Console: the commands the app ran, with their output.

scenarios.title: Back and Forward
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront; open src/cart.ts at line 30, then docs/checkout.md.
Click Go Back in the header: cart.ts at line 30 again.

scenarios.title: Terminal panel
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Click Terminal at the bottom of the left activity bar.
note: gm-measure writes a .zshrc into each app's throwaway HOME: a "$ " prompt, fixed text in the
theme's colors and styles, and the cursor hidden, as a blinking cursor differs by the moment of capture.

scenarios.title: Scripts panel
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Click the play button in the left activity bar (View > Scripts): the scripts of package.json.

scenarios.title: Update available
steps: Run a build older than the newest release on its channel and wait about 30 seconds.
Click Update available in the status bar: the update window.

scenarios.title: Editing src/catalog.ts with the Code menu
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront and open src/catalog.ts at line 2, column 3.
Code > Move Line Down, Code > Duplicate, Code > Comment with Line Comment.
Code > Select Next Occurrence twice: "id" is selected in two places, with the change markers in the gutter.

scenarios.title: Memory breakdown
steps: Start the app on demo/acme/storefront.
Click the memory readout at the right of the status bar.
